propositions: Recursive conftest glob pattern `tests/**/conftest.py` in global_support causes all seven mutation shards to be selected for any nested conftest change, wasting 5.38 runner-hours across 97 runs without increasing coverage.
Pytest loads only six specific ancestor conftests per shard (upward-only discovery), not sibling fixture trees like tests/external/live_jira_dc/conftest.py, making the recursive pattern incorrect.

Per-shard conftest support must be mapped to exact loaded ancestors: tests/unit/conftest.py for signing/compact-policy/push-policy; tests/interfaces/conftest.py for signing/reducer-processors/gates/next-batch/validate; tests/interfaces/store/conftest.py, tests/scripts/conftest.py, and tests/scripts/reducer/conftest.py for reducer-processors only.

A derived ancestry equality contract must expand configured test paths, compute ancestor conftests, and assert per-shard support closure matches derived set while pinning all existing mappings unchanged.
An unrelated nested conftest change must select zero mutation shards; each true ancestor conftest change must select exactly its dependent shards.
